name: semester-navigator
description: Connect school sources with guided setup, save a private semester plan, and get source-based study and writing support.

interface.shortDescription: Connect your school and see what needs your attention.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT guides school-account and browser connections, checks classes and coursework, and builds a private dashboard with visible source coverage. Resume interrupted setup, review work against rubrics, and enable verified reminders when available. Includes an upload-based web starter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Semester Navigator to set up my semester. Ask me questions one at a time and help me connect my school accounts.
